post_slowdown_asr_text: Counting cliffs on the moon led to questions about its inner heat. Then came the warmth of its coat, not how it feels to wear, but how well it holds heat in. The wrinkles were an important clue to how the moon cooled. Next time you look up at the moon, imagine the rock coat beneath its round shape, too. There is more to the moon's way of dressing than you can see.
